_comment: Which stops count as landmarks in the condensed stop list. A stop is a
landmark when its Thai or English name contains one of the strings
below (case-insensitive), unless it also contains one of `never`.
`major` tiers are always shown, except that a stop matching the same
keyword as the stop right before it is folded into it (two exits of
one station). `minor` tiers are shown only where a long stretch would
otherwise need an arbitrary stop for spacing: a junction or a market
beats 'Soi Lat Phrao 112', but is not worth a line of its own next to
a rail station. Tiers are tried in order; the tier name and the
matched keyword are what `bbc landmarks <route>` prints.
Termini and the stops nearest the user are always shown.
`include` / `exclude` force a stop by exact name.
